_comment: Copy this file to config.local.json and edit the paths. config.local.json is git-ignored. If no config.local.json exists, the tools fall back to the original developer paths (legacy mode).
_gameRoot: Root of an extracted/decrypted disc image: the folder that CONTAINS PS3_GAME/ and PS3_DISC.SFB. The tools read original game data from <gameRoot>/PS3_GAME/USRDIR/sirenx/data.
_hddData: RPCS3 HDD install data dir (dev_hdd0/game/BCJS30020/USRDIR/sirenx/data). Required for deployment and for regenerating chapter 9. Optional for pure build.
_workDir: Build workspace. Leave empty to use <repo>/work. Copy locales/<locale>/work/* here before a portable build (see BUILDING.md).
_mirrorDir: Hardlink mirror of the disc tree used for dual-write deployment. Leave empty for <repo>/build/mirror/...
_distDir: Output directory for the repacked disc data (a container that receives USRDIR/sirenx/data). Leave empty for <repo>/dist.
_font: Recorded for reference only. The effective font is set by `build.ps1 -Task rebuild -Font <name>` (writes work/font_cfg.json) or the ZH_FONT env var.
